description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal component, including factory creation methods, the main class with its methods, and internal data members related to Web Audio playback management within the Rialto server project.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of WebAudioPlayerServerInternal and WebAudioPlayer.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
classes.description: Main class implementing IWebAudioPlayer and IGstWebAudioPlayerClient, managing Web Audio playback, shared memory, and gstreamer integration.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: ~WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts audio playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses audio playback.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device capabilities.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Gets current volume.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client associated with this player.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies about state changes.

methods.name: initWebAudioPlayerInternal
methods.description: Initializes the WebAudioPlayer with given parameters.

methods.name: initGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the GStreamer WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: writeBufferInternal
methods.description: Handles internal buffer writing, to be called on main thread.

methods.name: writeStoredBuffers
methods.description: Writes stored buffer data to gstreamer.

methods.name: updateAvailableBuffer
methods.description: Updates buffer availability after writing.

methods.name: handleWriteDataTimer
methods.description: Handles timer timeout for writing data.

methods.name: getQueuedFramesInShm
methods.description: Returns number of frames queued in shared memory.
